description: This file defines a React context and provider component for managing and caching user and session data within a React application. It includes hooks for consuming the context and handles data fetching, error states, and loading states for users and sessions, loaded once at app mount.

methods.name: useDataContext
methods.description: Hook to consume the shared DataContext providing access to users and sessions data.

methods.name: DataProvider
methods.description: React component that initializes and provides cached user and session data, along with refresh functions, to its children.
